newsitem.title: USA: Procter & Gamble sees earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Procter & Gamble sees earnings growth.

text.p: Procter & Gamble Co Chairman and Chief Executive John Pepper told shareholders Tuesday that the company was "on track for another year of strong earnings growth."
The company would post record high earnings in the July-September period, Pepper told the annual shareholders meeting.
Procter & Gamble said sales in its pharmaceutical business grew 10 percent in 1995-96 and for the first time exceeded $500 million dollars.
The company said its new drug developments are encouraging.
